queue_identity.row_identity: 1-based order of immutable screen.required; original opaque pair IDs retained privately

source.attribution: Zou, Jeong, Pemula, Zhang and Dabeer, SPot-the-Difference, ECCV 2022; preserve source, license, notices and modifications.

scope: Existing 56 pairs only. Technical analysis and review-ready materials; no human reviewer currently registered. No additional pairs, masks, models, training, split changes or PCB3 payloads. Original 2F0 remains unchanged.
queue_order: Technical processing: test/train first, then others; anonymous HMAC ID tie order. Reviewer archive sorted anonymous IDs; no priority/order relation disclosed.
blinding: HMAC-SHA256(private 32-byte key, opaque a|b) first24 hex with P- prefix; last hex parity controls left/right. Key and mapping private. Only reviewer-bundle.zip can be handed to reviewer; sorted member names and fixed ZIP timestamps hide technical processing priority. Source filenames/labels/splits/scores absent from bundle. Same-workspace directories are workflow separation, not an OS access-control boundary.

technical.original_bytes_pixels_dimensions: Verify against frozen inventory before use; original dimension-qualified RGB hash formula unchanged.
technical.ssim: Pillow L then LANCZOS256x256 /255 float64; Gaussian11 sigma1.5; valid-window population moments; C1=.01^2 C2=.03^2; mean score. No classification threshold.
technical.translation: Single phase-only FFT cross-correlation on mean-centered grayscale256, no window; deterministic first maximum, wrap coordinate to [-127,128]; allow shift at most16 each axis. Compare SSIM on valid overlap only; no circular pixels. Constant norm<1e-12 => degenerate; outside bound => no aligned score. Not subpixel, rotation, scale or projective registration.
technical.local_features: No SIFT/ORB or keypoint/geometric classifier implemented. Existing NumPy/Pillow suffice for bounded translation/SSIM; repeated PCB layout makes correspondences insufficient for item identity. No new dependency.
technical.independence: SSIM/phase alignment differ from original dHash/pHash/RMS selection; they are correlated image evidence, not independent human/provenance evidence. Source filenames are identifiers, not documented physical-unit IDs.

criteria.CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE: Verified byte/pixel equality may be confirmed mechanically; nonexact derived/repeated captures need high-confidence independent blinded review with concrete unique landmarks or independently verified acquisition provenance.
criteria.CONFIRMED_RELATED: High-confidence independent evidence of same item/materially dependent capture, not layout resemblance.
criteria.CONFIRMED_DISTINCT: High-confidence positive evidence of separate items/captures without material duplication, with common-layout and mutable-damage alternatives addressed. Hash/illumination/damage differences alone insufficient.
criteria.UNRESOLVED: Missing independent reviewer/provenance; ambiguous/conflicting evidence; unsupported method; insufficient confidence. No fabricated identity, decision or date.
criteria.human_acceptance: Custodian verifies actual independent blinded identity and signed attestation; registered SHA256, two nonempty localized observations, concrete explanation and actual timezone-aware timestamp. Validator is consistency checking, not human authentication. No actual registry entries in this run.
criteria.groups: Exact and confirmed duplicate/related edges only, deterministic existing connected-component utility; distinct-versus-connected contradictions rejected. Uncertain edges remain separate.
criteria.stop: Any confirmed material train/test relation => BLOCKED immediately; do not process remaining pairs for a PASS. Technical/resource failure => INCONCLUSIVE; preserve partial evidence.
criteria.PASS: All56 resolved under these criteria, verified provenance, no material cross-partition group. No physical-independence guarantee.
criteria.current_human_availability: None provided or registered. Produce ready package and explicit technical UNRESOLVED dispositions where human judgment remains necessary.

exposure: Record every pair-side mechanical decode/render attempt before access. No automatic display to assistant/human. Actual future views require reviewer exposure log; package generation is not completed visual review. Label/split info is custodian-only.
reviewer_instructions:
LOCAL BLINDED IMAGE-INTEGRITY REVIEW ? DO NOT DISTRIBUTE

This archive contains anonymous pairs only. Keep it local. Do not seek filenames, labels, split membership, masks, model outputs or prior similarity rankings. The left and right images retain native decoded RGB pixels with a 16-pixel gray gutter; metadata is removed. Zoom using a local viewer when necessary. Rendered content itself may make defects apparent; annotation blinding cannot guarantee semantic blindness. Evaluate capture dependence only, not defect quality or model suitability.

Work through pairs.json in its anonymous order. Record every pair actually viewed, the actual UTC viewing/decision times and actual reviewer identity in a separate signed exposure record. Do not fabricate timestamps or fill future events. No review has occurred merely because this archive exists. response-template.json contains blank fields, not decisions.

Use CONFIRMED_DUPLICATE for convincingly demonstrated repeated or derived captures; CONFIRMED_RELATED for the same physical item or materially dependent captures; CONFIRMED_DISTINCT only when positive evidence establishes separate items/captures without material duplication; otherwise UNRESOLVED. High confidence and concrete evidence are required for every resolved outcome. Record at least two localized object-specific landmarks (coordinates/regions and descriptions), explain the common-layout alternative, and cite independent acquisition evidence if available. Different lighting, orientation, damage, missing parts, filenames or differing hashes alone cannot establish distinct items. Shared layout or high visual similarity cannot establish the same item. Changed defects could be the same board photographed again. Do not force a decision.

Reviewer must be independent of model development and prior unblinded pair analysis; attest to actual independence and blinding. A custodian must verify the identity, scope, evidence and signed attestation before accepting decisions. A software validator checks schema/consistency only; it cannot authenticate human independence or factual observations. Do not inspect the restricted audit mapping or the original reports. Return observations locally to the owner; no external submission is authorized. Conflicting or insufficient evidence stays UNRESOLVED.
